objective: Make performance and resource evidence strict, finite and portable before any percentile or report is produced, so NaN, Infinity, negative values, malformed units and wrong identity types fail closed with path and line diagnostics instead of entering a report.
acceptance: timestamp, level, service, source, run_id, event and message are validated as non-empty strings so grouping keys stay hashable and comparable
an unhashable or non-string run_id produces a path and line diagnostic instead of an internal TypeError during grouping
durations are finite, non-negative and bounded, and the bound is a named constant rather than a literal
docker CPU percentages and memory values are finite, non-negative and bounded, and a genuine multi-core reading above 100 percent is still accepted
negative and malformed memory values such as -1MiB are rejected
reports are serialized with allow_nan=False and written atomically, so a non-finite value cannot produce a file that is not valid JSON and a failure cannot leave a half-written report
sequence, hardware-hash and source validation from the existing implementation are unchanged
every new boundary has a test that fails when the corresponding guard is removed
commands: python3 -m ruff check tools/scripts/performance_tools.py tools/scripts/analyze_telemetry.py tools/scripts/benchmark_resources.py tests/unit/test_performance_tools.py
evidence: focused evidence-boundary test output for non-finite and negative durations, non-finite and negative CPU, negative and oversized memory, wrong identity types, and atomic report writing
demonstration that the focused tests fail when the guards are neutralized and pass with the fix
confirmation that the pre-existing performance tool tests still pass unchanged
full repository test and Task Packet gate output
stop_conditions: an upper bound must differ per deployment, which is a policy decision rather than an evidence-validation fix
worker-count normalisation for multi-core CPU percentages is required, which would change what the metric means
an interfaces schema or libs/contracts change is required
a modification outside allowed_paths is required
